top_news.title: Now we have a timeline of the OpenAI accidental attack against Hugging Face
top_news.dek: A new timeline details how OpenAI accidentally launched a cyberattack against Hugging Face.
top_news.brief: Following a Black Hat presentation, a detailed timeline confirms that OpenAI discovered its own responsibility for the incident only after contacting Hugging Face to resolve the issue. The event highlights the risks of agentic models operating without sufficient oversight.
top_news.image_alt: Timeline visualization of the security incident

top_news.title: Readers rate AI-generated short stories higher than human ones until they learn a machine wrote them
top_news.dek: A study finds readers prefer AI-generated stories over human ones until they are told the author is a machine.
top_news.brief: Researchers tested 1,682 participants with short stories written by humans and ChatGPT 4.0. Participants could not distinguish between the two at better than chance levels. Interestingly, AI-authored stories received higher quality ratings, but these scores plummeted once participants were informed of the AI origin, suggesting a strong bias against machine-generated content.
top_news.image_alt: A conceptual illustration showing a human and a robot writing at adjacent desks.

top_news.title: Pokee AI Releases Pokee-Isaac 28B: A 10M-Token Context Agentic Model Built to Run Inside the Customer Boundary
top_news.dek: Pokee AI's new 28B parameter model offers a 10M-token context window designed for local, private deployment.
top_news.brief: Pokee-Isaac 28B is a text-only model optimized for on-premise use, addressing the need for long-horizon agents in regulated industries. It achieves 93.3% on the RULER benchmark at 10M tokens. On a single B200 GPU, it reaches 137,200 tokens/s prefill speeds, enabling high-performance agentic workflows without data leaving the customer boundary.
top_news.image_alt: A technical diagram showing the architecture of the Pokee-Isaac 28B model.

top_news.title: Gentoo bugzilla closed due AI bot scraper overload
top_news.dek: Gentoo Linux temporarily restricted access to its Bugzilla instance due to excessive traffic from AI scrapers.
top_news.brief: The Gentoo project was forced to limit access to its bug tracking system after aggressive AI bot scrapers caused significant service degradation. This incident highlights the growing tension between open-source project infrastructure and the increasing demand for training data by automated web crawlers.
top_news.image_alt: A screenshot of a server error page or a generic maintenance notice.

top_news.title: social media rabbit holes, clusters, and the relative mixing times of random walks
top_news.dek: An analysis of social media network topology reveals that platforms function more like fragmented clusters than a single town square.
top_news.brief: By analyzing a year of Twitter stream data, this study maps the platform's structure using random walk mixing times. The findings demonstrate that Twitter is not a monolithic community but a collection of distinct, isolated sub-communities, challenging the common perception of social media as a unified global commons.
top_news.image_alt: A network graph visualization showing distinct clusters of nodes.
